question (en): What does `typeof "42"` return in JavaScript?
right answer (en): "string"
wrong 1: "number"
wrong 2: "integer"
wrong 3: "object"
why (en): The value is in quotes, so it is a string whatever it contains.
question (ar): ما ناتج `typeof "42"` في جافاسكربت؟
why (ar): القيمة بين علامتي تنصيص، فهي نص مهما كان محتواها.

question (en): When should you use `const` instead of `let`?
right answer (en): When the variable will never be reassigned
wrong 1: Only when the value is a number
wrong 2: Whenever the variable is inside a loop
wrong 3: There is no difference
why (en): `const` forbids reassignment, which documents intent and prevents accidental changes.
question (ar): متى تستخدم `const` بدل `let`؟
why (ar): `const` يمنع إعادة الإسناد، فيوضّح نيّتك ويمنع أخطاء التعديل غير المقصود.

question (en): What do `0 == "0"` and `0 === "0"` give?
right answer (en): true, false
wrong 1: false, true
wrong 2: true, true
wrong 3: false, false
why (en): `==` converts the string to a number before comparing; `===` also compares the type.
why (ar): `==` يحوّل النص إلى عدد قبل المقارنة، أما `===` فيقارن النوع أيضًا.

question (en): Which loop is the natural choice for visiting every item of an array?
right answer (en): for...of
wrong 1: while (true)
wrong 2: do...while
wrong 3: if...else
why (en): `for...of` hands you each item directly with no counter to manage.
question (ar): أي حلقة أنسب للمرور على كل عناصر مصفوفة؟
why (ar): `for...of` يعطيك كل عنصر مباشرة دون إدارة عدّاد.

question (en): What makes a function "good"?
right answer (en): It does one job and its name describes it
wrong 1: It is long enough to cover every case
wrong 2: It changes many global variables
wrong 3: It never returns a value
why (en): Small single-purpose functions are easier to read, test and reuse.
question (ar): ما الذي يجعل الدالة «جيدة»؟
why (ar): الدوال الصغيرة ذات الهدف الواحد أسهل في القراءة والاختبار وإعادة الاستخدام.

question (en): What happens if a `while` loop's condition never changes?
right answer (en): An infinite loop that freezes the program
wrong 1: The loop exits on its own after a timeout
wrong 2: The engine detects it and skips the loop
wrong 3: It runs once and then reports an error
why (en): There is no automatic limit; each pass must move the condition toward false.
question (ar): ماذا يحدث إذا لم يتغير شرط حلقة `while` أبدًا؟
why (ar): لا يوجد حدّ تلقائي؛ يجب أن يقترب الشرط من أن يصبح false في كل دورة.

question (en): Which structure fits an editor's "undo" button?
right answer (en): Stack
wrong 1: Queue
wrong 2: Hash table
wrong 3: Graph
why (en): The last edit must be undone first, which is exactly the stack's LIFO order.
question (ar): أي بنية تناسب زر «تراجع» في محرر نصوص؟
why (ar): آخر تعديل يجب أن يُلغى أولًا، وهذا هو مبدأ LIFO في المكدس.

question (en): What is the average lookup time for a key in a hash table?
wrong 1: O(n)
wrong 2: O(log n)
wrong 3: O(n²)
why (en): The hash function leads straight to the key's slot, unless there are many collisions.
question (ar): ما متوسط زمن البحث عن مفتاح في جدول تجزئة؟
why (ar): دالة التجزئة تقودك مباشرة إلى موقع المفتاح، إلا عند تصادمات كثيرة.

question (en): What is an array's weakness compared with a linked list?
right answer (en): Inserting in the middle shifts the other items
wrong 1: Reading an item by its index is slow
wrong 2: You cannot loop over its items in order
wrong 3: It cannot hold items of different types
why (en): Every item after the insertion point moves one slot, which is O(n).
question (ar): ما عيب المصفوفة مقارنة بالقائمة المترابطة؟
right answer (ar): الإدراج في المنتصف يتطلب إزاحة العناصر
why (ar): كل عنصر بعد موضع الإدراج ينزاح خانة، وهذا O(n).

question (en): A print queue prints documents in arrival order. Which structure is it?
right answer (en): Queue (FIFO)
wrong 1: Stack (LIFO)
wrong 2: Tree
wrong 3: Set
why (en): The first document to arrive is the first one printed.
question (ar): طابور طباعة يطبع المستندات بترتيب وصولها. ما البنية؟
why (ar): أول مستند يصل هو أول ما يُطبع.

question (en): When is search in a binary search tree O(log n)?
right answer (en): When the tree is balanced
wrong 1: Always, whatever its shape
wrong 2: When all values are equal
wrong 3: When stored in an unsorted array
why (en): A lopsided tree behaves like a linked list, so search degrades to O(n).
question (ar): متى يكون البحث في شجرة بحث ثنائية O(log n)؟
why (ar): الشجرة المائلة تصبح كقائمة مترابطة فيصير البحث O(n).

question (en): Which algorithm finds the shortest path (by edge count) in an unweighted graph?
right answer (en): BFS
wrong 1: DFS
wrong 2: Binary search
wrong 3: Bubble sort
why (en): Breadth-first search explores layer by layer, so the first time it reaches the target is the shortest path.
question (ar): أي خوارزمية تجد أقصر مسار (بعدد الحواف) في رسم بياني غير موزون؟
why (ar): البحث بالعرض يستكشف الطبقات بالترتيب، فأول وصول إلى الهدف هو الأقصر.

question (en): Two nested loops each run over n items. What is the complexity?
right answer (en): O(n²)
wrong 1: O(n)
wrong 2: O(2n)
wrong 3: O(log n)
why (en): For each outer item the inner loop visits n items: n × n.
question (ar): حلقتان متداخلتان كل منهما تمر على n عنصر. ما التعقيد؟
why (ar): لكل عنصر في الحلقة الخارجية تمر الداخلية على n عنصر: n × n.

question (en): What does binary search require?
right answer (en): The data must be sorted
wrong 1: The data must be numbers
wrong 2: The size must be even
wrong 3: No repeated values
why (en): Without order you cannot tell which half to discard.
question (ar): ما الشرط الأساسي للبحث الثنائي؟
why (ar): بدون ترتيب لا يمكن تحديد أي نصف نحذف.

question (en): What does `[10, 9, 1].sort()` give in JavaScript?
why (en): Without a compare function values are compared as strings: "1", "10", "9".
question (ar): ما ناتج `[10, 9, 1].sort()` في جافاسكربت؟
why (ar): بدون دالة مقارنة تُقارن القيم كنصوص: "1" ثم "10" ثم "9".

question (en): About how many comparisons does binary search need for one million items?
why (en): 2²⁰ ≈ one million, and every comparison halves the range.
question (ar): كم مقارنة تقريبًا يحتاج البحث الثنائي في مليون عنصر؟
why (ar): 2²⁰ ≈ مليون، وكل مقارنة تقسم المجال على اثنين.

question (en): What stops a recursive function from calling itself forever?
right answer (en): The base case
wrong 1: A while loop
wrong 2: Global variables
wrong 3: The garbage collector
why (en): The base case returns a result directly without another call.
question (ar): ما الذي يمنع الدالة الذاتية من الاستدعاء إلى الأبد؟
why (ar): حالة الأساس تُرجع نتيجة مباشرة دون استدعاء جديد.

question (en): What is the idea behind dynamic programming?
right answer (en): Storing results of repeated subproblems
wrong 1: Running code on several servers
wrong 2: Always taking the best local choice
wrong 3: Writing code with no variables
why (en): Each subproblem is solved once and its answer is reused from memory.
question (ar): ما فكرة البرمجة الديناميكية؟
why (ar): كل مسألة فرعية تُحل مرة واحدة وتُعاد نتيجتها من الذاكرة.

question (en): What is encapsulation?
right answer (en): Hiding internals behind a clear interface
wrong 1: Copying one class's code into another class to reuse it
wrong 2: Running the same code on several processor cores
wrong 3: Encrypting the source code so others cannot read it
why (en): The object protects its data and only lets validated methods change it.
question (ar): ما التغليف؟
right answer (ar): إخفاء التفاصيل الداخلية خلف واجهة واضحة
why (ar): الكائن يحمي بياناته ويسمح بتغييرها فقط عبر دوال تتحقق منها.

question (en): Which SOLID principle says "a class should have one reason to change"?
right answer (en): Single responsibility (S)
wrong 1: Open/closed (O)
wrong 2: Liskov substitution (L)
wrong 3: Dependency inversion (D)
why (en): A class that calculates, prints and stores has three reasons to change, so split it.
question (ar): أي مبدأ من SOLID يقول «لكل صنف سبب واحد للتغيير»؟
why (ar): صنف يجمع الحسابات والطباعة والتخزين معًا يتغير لثلاثة أسباب، فيُقسَّم.

question (en): Every shape has an `area()` computed its own way. What is this concept called?
right answer (en): Polymorphism
wrong 1: Encapsulation
wrong 2: Data hiding
wrong 3: Recursion
why (en): One message, with behaviour that depends on the object's type.
question (ar): كل الأشكال لها دالة `area()` تحسبها بطريقتها. ما اسم هذا المفهوم؟
why (ar): الرسالة نفسها، وسلوك يختلف حسب نوع الكائن.

question (en): Why prefer composition over deep inheritance?
right answer (en): Long inheritance chains are fragile and hard to change
wrong 1: JavaScript limits how deep inheritance can go
wrong 2: Composition always runs faster at runtime
wrong 3: Inheritance cannot share methods between classes
why (en): Changing a parent ripples into every child; composition assembles independent parts.
question (ar): لماذا يُنصح بتفضيل التركيب على الوراثة العميقة؟
right answer (ar): لأن سلاسل الوراثة الطويلة هشة وصعبة التغيير
why (ar): تغيير الصنف الأب يؤثر في كل الأبناء؛ التركيب يجمع قطعًا مستقلة.

question (en): What does `#` before a field name mean in a JavaScript class?
right answer (en): A private field, unreadable outside the class
wrong 1: A comment that the engine ignores
wrong 2: A constant that can never change
wrong 3: A field saved automatically to storage
why (en): Private fields enforce encapsulation in the language itself.
question (ar): ماذا تعني `#` قبل اسم حقل في صنف جافاسكربت؟
right answer (ar): حقل خاص لا يُقرأ من خارج الصنف
why (ar): الحقول الخاصة تفرض التغليف على مستوى اللغة نفسها.

question (en): What is high coupling?
right answer (en): Parts depend heavily on each other's details
wrong 1: Many comments describing each function
wrong 2: Classes that share one database table
wrong 3: Code split into many small files
why (en): With high coupling a small change breaks many parts.
question (ar): ما الاقتران (coupling) العالي؟
right answer (ar): اعتماد الأجزاء على تفاصيل بعضها بشدة
why (ar): مع الاقتران العالي يكسر تغيير صغير أجزاء كثيرة.

question (en): Which pattern fits "several interchangeable payment methods behind one interface"?
right answer (en): Strategy
wrong 1: Singleton
wrong 2: Observer
wrong 3: Adapter
why (en): Each payment method is a strategy; the code picks one at run time.
question (ar): أي نمط يناسب «عدة طرق دفع قابلة للتبديل خلف واجهة واحدة»؟
why (ar): كل طريقة دفع استراتيجية، والكود يختار واحدة وقت التشغيل.

question (en): Why can a singleton make testing harder?
right answer (en): It is global state shared across tests
wrong 1: It makes every call noticeably slower
wrong 2: It forbids subclasses of the class
wrong 3: It must always connect to a database
why (en): State from one test can leak into another through the single instance.
question (ar): لماذا قد يصعّب نمط المفرد الاختبار؟
right answer (ar): لأنه حالة عامة مشتركة بين الاختبارات
why (ar): حالة اختبار قد تتسرب إلى اختبار آخر عبر النسخة الوحيدة.

question (en): A third-party library exposes `makePayment(cents)` but your code expects `pay(amount)`. What do you write?
right answer (en): An adapter
wrong 1: A factory
wrong 2: An observer
wrong 3: A singleton
why (en): The adapter translates between the two interfaces without changing either.
question (ar): مكتبة دفع خارجية واجهتها `makePayment(cents)`، وكودك يتوقع `pay(amount)`. ماذا تكتب؟
why (ar): المحوّل يترجم بين الواجهتين دون تعديل أيٍّ منهما.

question (en): What does dependency injection give you?
right answer (en): Easy swapping of dependencies for fakes in tests
wrong 1: Automatic encryption of every dependency you load
wrong 2: Shorter code, because classes are no longer needed
wrong 3: Automatic updates of every library the app uses
why (en): The object doesn't build its own tools, so you hand it whatever you like.
question (ar): ما فائدة حقن الاعتماديات؟
right answer (ar): سهولة استبدال الاعتماديات بنسخ وهمية في الاختبارات
why (ar): الكائن لا ينشئ أدواته، فتمرر له ما تشاء.

question (en): What is refactoring?
right answer (en): Improving code structure without changing behaviour
wrong 1: Adding new features
wrong 2: Rewriting the project in another language
wrong 3: Deleting old tests
why (en): Behaviour stays the same, and tests prove it after every step.
question (ar): ما إعادة الهيكلة (Refactoring)؟
right answer (ar): تحسين بنية الكود دون تغيير سلوكه
why (ar): السلوك يبقى كما هو، والاختبارات تثبت ذلك بعد كل خطوة.

question (en): Browser click events are an example of which pattern?
right answer (en): Observer
wrong 1: Factory
wrong 2: Strategy
wrong 3: Adapter
why (en): `addEventListener` registers a subscriber that runs when the event fires.
question (ar): أحداث النقر في المتصفح مثال على أي نمط؟
why (ar): `addEventListener` يسجّل مشتركًا يُستدعى عند وقوع الحدث.

question (en): What is a commit in Git?
right answer (en): A saved snapshot of the files with a message
wrong 1: A backup on an external drive
wrong 2: The repository's config file
wrong 3: A command that deletes old branches
why (en): Each commit is a point in history you can return to.
question (ar): ما الإيداع (commit) في Git؟
why (ar): كل إيداع نقطة في التاريخ يمكنك العودة إليها.

question (en): Why build a feature on a separate branch?
right answer (en): So `main` stays releasable
wrong 1: Git forbids commits to main
wrong 2: To make the computer faster
wrong 3: To hide the code from the team
why (en): Unfinished work stays isolated until it is reviewed and merged.
question (ar): لماذا نعمل على ميزة في فرع منفصل؟
why (ar): العمل غير المكتمل يبقى معزولًا حتى يُراجَع ويُدمج.

question (en): When does a merge conflict happen?
right answer (en): When two branches edit the same lines
wrong 1: When there are more than two branches
wrong 2: When the commit message is long
wrong 3: When merging a branch with no changes
why (en): Git can't tell which edit you want, so it asks you.
question (ar): متى يحدث تعارض دمج؟
why (ar): Git لا يعرف أي التعديلين تريد، فيطلب قرارك.

question (en): You shipped a bad commit to a shared branch. What is the safe way to undo it?
right answer (en): git revert
wrong 1: git push --force
wrong 2: git reset --hard on main
wrong 3: Delete the repository
why (en): `revert` adds a reverse commit and doesn't rewrite history others rely on.
question (ar): أطلقت إيداعًا فيه خطأ على فرع مشترك. ما الطريقة الآمنة للتراجع؟
why (ar): `revert` يضيف إيداعًا عكسيًا ولا يعيد كتابة تاريخ يعتمد عليه الآخرون.

question (en): What is a pull request mainly for?
right answer (en): Reviewing and testing changes before merging
wrong 1: Downloading a full copy of the repository
wrong 2: Deleting a branch after it is merged
wrong 3: Backing up the code to another server
why (en): Review catches bugs and spreads knowledge across the team.
question (ar): ما الغرض الأساسي من طلب السحب (Pull Request)؟
why (ar): المراجعة تلتقط الأخطاء وتنشر المعرفة في الفريق.

question (en): Which commit message is better?
right answer (en): "Lock account after 5 failed logins"
wrong 1: "changes"
wrong 2: "fix"
wrong 3: "today's work"
why (en): A good message tells a reader a year later what changed and why.
question (ar): أي رسالة إيداع أفضل؟
why (ar): الرسالة الجيدة تخبر القارئ بعد سنة بما تغيّر ولماذا.

question (en): Which kind of test should be the most numerous?
right answer (en): Unit tests
wrong 1: End-to-end tests
wrong 2: Manual tests
wrong 3: Performance tests
why (en): They are fast, precise and pinpoint where a bug is.
question (ar): أي نوع اختبار يجب أن يكون الأكثر عددًا؟
why (ar): سريعة ودقيقة وتحدد مكان الخطأ بالضبط.

question (en): What is the first step of the TDD loop?
right answer (en): Write a failing test
wrong 1: Write all the code
wrong 2: Refactor
wrong 3: Deploy the app
why (en): The failing test defines exactly what the code must do.
question (ar): ما الخطوة الأولى في دورة TDD؟
why (ar): الاختبار الفاشل يحدد بدقة ما يجب أن يفعله الكود.

question (en): Coverage is 100%. Does that mean there are no bugs?
right answer (en): No: running a line isn't checking it is right
wrong 1: Yes: if every line ran, every line was checked
wrong 2: Yes, provided every test in the suite passes
wrong 3: Only when the tests also run in under a second
why (en): A test without good assertions can run every line and still catch nothing.
question (ar): التغطية 100%. هل يعني ذلك عدم وجود أخطاء؟
right answer (ar): لا، تنفيذ السطر لا يعني التحقق من صحته
why (ar): اختبار بلا تحققات جيدة قد يمر على كل الأسطر دون أن يكتشف شيئًا.

question (en): What is regression testing for?
right answer (en): Making sure a new change didn't break old features
wrong 1: Measuring how fast the server responds
wrong 2: Checking that new code follows the style guide
wrong 3: Making sure the new feature looks right
why (en): Old tests are rerun after every change.
question (ar): ما الغرض من الاختبار الارتدادي؟
right answer (ar): التأكد أن التغيير الجديد لم يكسر ميزات قديمة
why (ar): يعاد تشغيل الاختبارات القديمة بعد كل تغيير.

question (en): What is the structure of a good test?
right answer (en): Arrange, act, assert
wrong 1: Assert, arrange, act
wrong 2: Act only
wrong 3: Deploy, then test
why (en): A clear structure makes a test read like documentation.
question (ar): ما ترتيب أجزاء الاختبار الجيد؟
why (ar): وضوح البنية يجعل الاختبار سهل القراءة كالوثيقة.

question (en): `discount` gives 10% off from 100. Which test value checks the boundary?
wrong 1: 50 and 60
wrong 3: 0 only
why (en): Bugs hide at boundaries: is the condition > or ≥?
question (ar): دالة `discount` تعطي خصمًا من 100. أي قيمة اختبار تكشف الحالة الحدية؟
why (ar): الأخطاء تختبئ عند الحدود: هل الشرط > أم ≥؟

question (en): Which HTTP method creates a new resource?
right answer (en): POST
wrong 1: GET
wrong 2: DELETE
wrong 3: HEAD
why (en): `GET` is for reading only and must not change data.
question (ar): أي طريقة HTTP تُستخدم لإنشاء مورد جديد؟
why (ar): `GET` للقراءة فقط ويجب ألا يغير البيانات.

question (en): The user is logged in but lacks permission for the resource. Which status code fits?
right answer (en): 403 Forbidden
wrong 1: 401 Unauthorized
wrong 2: 404 Not Found
wrong 3: 500 Internal Server Error
why (en): 401 means identity is unknown; 403 means it is known but not allowed.
question (ar): المستخدم مسجّل دخوله لكنه لا يملك صلاحية المورد. ما الرمز الصحيح؟
why (ar): 401 تعني أن الهوية غير معروفة، و403 أنها معروفة لكنها غير مسموح لها.

question (en): Which path follows REST style?
right answer (en): GET /orders/42
wrong 1: GET /getOrder?id=42
wrong 2: POST /deleteOrder/42
wrong 3: GET /orders/42/delete
why (en): The resource is a noun; the verb is the HTTP method itself.
question (ar): أي مسار يتبع أسلوب REST؟
why (ar): المورد اسم، والفعل هو طريقة HTTP نفسها.

question (en): What does status 429 mean?
right answer (en): Too many requests
wrong 1: The resource moved to a new address
wrong 2: The server is down for maintenance
wrong 3: The request succeeded but returned nothing
why (en): The server is rate-limiting to protect itself.
question (ar): ماذا يعني الرمز 429؟
why (ar): الخادم يطبق حدًّا لمعدل الطلبات لحماية نفسه.

question (en): What happens first when you type a site address?
right answer (en): A DNS lookup for the IP address
wrong 1: Downloading CSS
wrong 2: Running JavaScript
wrong 3: Sending cookies to every site
why (en): You can't connect to the server before knowing its address.
question (ar): ما أول خطوة عندما تكتب عنوان موقع في المتصفح؟
why (ar): لا يمكن الاتصال بالخادم قبل معرفة عنوانه.

question (en): What does a CDN do?
right answer (en): Serves static files from servers close to the user
wrong 1: Runs back-end code on servers close to the database
wrong 2: Stores user passwords on servers in many countries
wrong 3: Replaces the database with a faster cached copy
why (en): Shorter distance means faster loads and less load on the origin server.
question (ar): ما فائدة شبكة توزيع المحتوى CDN؟
right answer (ar): تقدّم الملفات الثابتة من خوادم قريبة من المستخدم
why (ar): المسافة الأقصر تعني تحميلًا أسرع وضغطًا أقل على الخادم الأصلي.

question (en): What does a foreign key do?
right answer (en): Links a row to a row in another table
wrong 1: Encrypts the column
wrong 2: Speeds up every query
wrong 3: Removes duplicates automatically
why (en): Like `customer_id` in orders, which points to the customer.
question (ar): ما وظيفة المفتاح الأجنبي؟
right answer (ar): يربط صفًا بصف في جدول آخر
why (ar): مثل `customer_id` في جدول الطلبات الذي يشير إلى العميل.

question (en): Which join returns every customer, even those with no orders?
right answer (en): customers LEFT JOIN orders
wrong 1: customers INNER JOIN orders
wrong 2: orders INNER JOIN customers
wrong 3: CROSS JOIN only

wrong 3: CSRF
why (en): The server never checked ownership of the resource before returning it.
question (ar): يغيّر مستخدم `id=1001` إلى `id=1002` في الرابط فيرى بيانات عميل آخر. ما الثغرة؟
why (ar): الخادم لم يتحقق من ملكية المورد قبل إرساله.

question (en): What is the correct fix for SQL injection?
right answer (en): Parameterised queries
wrong 1: Stripping quotes from input
wrong 2: Only hiding error messages
wrong 3: Encrypting the database
why (en): Keeping data separate from code means it is never interpreted as commands, whatever it contains.
question (ar): ما العلاج الصحيح لحقن SQL؟
why (ar): فصل البيانات عن الكود يمنع تفسيرها كأوامر مهما كان محتواها.

question (en): Which line safely shows a user's comment on the page?
right answer (en): el.textContent = comment
wrong 1: el.innerHTML = comment
wrong 2: document.write(comment)
wrong 3: eval(comment)
why (en): `textContent` shows text literally and never runs tags.
question (ar): أي سطر آمن لعرض تعليق مستخدم في الصفحة؟
why (ar): `textContent` يعرض النص حرفيًا ولا ينفّذ أي وسوم.

question (en): What protects against CSRF?
right answer (en): CSRF tokens and SameSite cookies
wrong 1: Longer passwords for every account
wrong 2: Encrypting the cookie's value
wrong 3: A network firewall in front of the site
why (en): The malicious site can't know the secret token, and the browser won't send the cookie cross-site.
question (ar): ما الذي يحمي من CSRF؟
why (ar): الموقع الخبيث لا يعرف الرمز السري، والمتصفح لا يرسل الملف عبر المواقع.

question (en): A server fetches an image from a user-supplied URL; the attacker sends the internal cloud metadata URL. What attack is this?
right answer (en): SSRF
wrong 1: CSRF
wrong 2: XSS
wrong 3: IDOR
why (en): The server itself becomes a tool for reaching the internal network.
question (ar): خادم يجلب صورة من رابط يرسله المستخدم، فيرسل المهاجم رابط خدمة بيانات السحابة الداخلية. ما الهجوم؟
why (ar): الخادم نفسه أصبح أداة للوصول إلى الشبكة الداخلية.

question (en): An error page shows the SQL query and file paths to users. This is an example of:
right answer (en): Security misconfiguration
wrong 1: Weak cryptography on the database
wrong 2: A zero-day flaw in the framework
wrong 3: A denial-of-service attack in progress
why (en): Technical details help attackers; show a generic message and log the details internally.
question (ar): رسالة خطأ تعرض نص الاستعلام ومسار الملفات للمستخدم. هذا مثال على:
why (ar): التفاصيل التقنية تساعد المهاجم؛ اعرض رسالة عامة وسجّل التفاصيل داخليًا.

question (en): What is the best approach to input validation?
right answer (en): An allow-list checked on the server
wrong 1: A block-list in the browser only
wrong 2: Trusting input from logged-in users
wrong 3: Only trimming spaces
why (en): The browser can be bypassed and a block-list never covers every case.
question (ar): ما أفضل طريقة للتحقق من المُدخلات؟
why (ar): المتصفح يمكن تجاوزه، والقائمة المحجوبة لا تحصي كل الاحتمالات.

question (en): A developer committed an API key to Git and deleted it in the next commit. Is it fixed?
right answer (en): No: it stays in history and must be rotated now
wrong 1: Yes, the next commit removed it from the code
wrong 2: Yes, as long as the repository is private
wrong 3: Only if the file holding it is also renamed
why (en): Anyone with a copy of the repository can read the old commit.
question (ar): طوّر أودع مفتاح API في Git ثم حذفه في إيداع لاحق. هل المشكلة حُلّت؟
right answer (ar): لا، المفتاح باقٍ في التاريخ ويجب تبديله فورًا
why (ar): أي شخص يملك نسخة من المستودع يستطيع قراءة الإيداع القديم.

question (en): What do `npm audit` and SCA tools do?
right answer (en): Find known vulnerabilities in dependencies
wrong 1: Encrypt your source code before release
wrong 2: Speed up the build by caching packages
wrong 3: Write unit tests for your dependencies
why (en): They compare your library versions with public vulnerability databases.
question (ar): ما فائدة `npm audit` وأدوات SCA؟
right answer (ar): تكشف ثغرات معروفة في المكتبات التابعة
why (ar): تقارن إصدارات مكتباتك بقواعد بيانات الثغرات المعلنة.

question (en): The permission check crashes with an error. What should happen?
right answer (en): Access is denied (fail closed)
wrong 1: Access is granted so work continues
wrong 2: The stack trace is shown to the user
wrong 3: The server restarts with no logging
why (en): An error must never become a back door.
question (ar): نظام التحقق من الصلاحيات تعطل بسبب خطأ. ماذا يجب أن يحدث؟
why (ar): الخطأ لا يجب أن يصبح بابًا خلفيًا.

question (en): Where should a payment gateway key live?
right answer (en): In a secrets manager or environment variable
wrong 1: Hard-coded in the front-end JavaScript
wrong 2: In the project's README for the team
wrong 3: In a comment above the payment function
why (en): Code gets copied and shared; secrets are managed and rotated separately.
question (ar): أين يُحفظ مفتاح بوابة الدفع؟
right answer (ar): في خدمة إدارة أسرار أو متغير بيئة
why (ar): الكود يُنسخ ويُشارك، أما الأسرار فتُدار وتُبدّل بشكل منفصل.

question (en): What is static analysis (SAST)?
right answer (en): Scanning source code without running it
wrong 1: Attacking the running app with crafted requests
wrong 2: Watching network traffic for suspicious patterns
wrong 3: Load-testing the app with many fake users
why (en): SAST reads code; DAST tests the running application.
question (ar): ما التحليل الساكن (SAST)؟
why (ar): SAST يقرأ الكود، أما DAST فيختبر التطبيق وهو يعمل.

question (en): Which kind spreads across the network by itself, with no user action?
right answer (en): Worm
wrong 1: Virus
wrong 2: Trojan
wrong 3: Adware
why (en): A worm exploits a flaw to copy itself from machine to machine.
question (ar): أي نوع ينتشر وحده عبر الشبكة دون تدخل المستخدم؟
why (ar): الدودة تستغل ثغرة لتنسخ نفسها من جهاز إلى آخر.

question (en): An email from "support@paypa1-security.com" asks you to confirm your account within an hour. What is the clearest red flag?
right answer (en): A look-alike sender domain plus urgency
wrong 1: The message is written in English, not Arabic
wrong 2: It arrived early in the morning before work
wrong 3: It shows the company logo at the top
why (en): The digit 1 replacing the letter l, plus time pressure, are classic phishing tricks.
question (ar): بريد من «support@paypa1-security.com» يطلب تأكيد الحساب خلال ساعة. ما أوضح علامة تحذير؟
why (ar): الرقم 1 بدل الحرف l، والضغط الزمني من أساليب التصيد الكلاسيكية.

question (en): What is the best protection from ransomware once infection happens?
right answer (en): Offline, tested backups
wrong 1: Paying the ransom at once to save time
wrong 2: Rebooting every machine to clear the malware
wrong 3: Running a full antivirus scan on the server
why (en): Offline copies can't be encrypted by the malware, and testing proves restore works.
question (ar): ما أفضل حماية من برامج الفدية بعد وقوع الإصابة؟
why (ar): النسخ غير المتصلة لا يستطيع البرنامج تشفيرها، والتجربة تضمن أن الاستعادة تعمل.

question (en): How does MITRE ATT&CK help defenders?
right answer (en): It catalogues attacker techniques to measure detection coverage
wrong 1: It blocks known attack techniques automatically
wrong 2: It encrypts traffic between offices and the cloud
wrong 3: It ranks security vendors by detection rate
why (en): It's a shared language for what attackers do and what we can see.
question (ar): ما فائدة إطار MITRE ATT&CK للمدافعين؟
right answer (ar): يفهرس تقنيات المهاجمين لقياس تغطية الكشف
why (ar): هو لغة مشتركة لوصف ما يفعله المهاجم وما نستطيع رصده.

question (en): What is a zero-day?
right answer (en): A flaw unknown to the vendor with no patch yet
wrong 1: A flaw found exactly one day after release
wrong 2: An attack launched at midnight on day zero
wrong 3: Software that has had no flaws reported yet
why (en): That is why patching alone isn't enough and other layers are needed.
question (ar): ما ثغرة اليوم صفر؟
right answer (ar): ثغرة غير معروفة للمصنّع ولا رقعة لها بعد
why (ar): لهذا لا يكفي التحديث وحده، ونحتاج طبقات دفاع أخرى.

question (en): "IT support" calls asking for the code you just got by text. What do you do?
right answer (en): Refuse and report it to security
wrong 1: Give it if they're polite
wrong 2: Give half the code
wrong 3: Ignore it without reporting
why (en): Real support never asks for verification codes.
question (ar): اتصل «الدعم الفني» يطلب رمز التحقق الذي وصلك برسالة. ماذا تفعل؟
why (ar): الدعم الحقيقي لا يطلب رموز التحقق أبدًا.

question (en): Fifty failed logins then a success from the same address. What does it most likely mean?
right answer (en): A successful password-guessing attack
wrong 1: A user forgot their password once
wrong 2: A server fault
wrong 3: An automatic update
why (en): It's the classic pattern of brute force or credential stuffing.
question (ar): خمسون محاولة دخول فاشلة ثم دخول ناجح من العنوان نفسه. ماذا يعني ذلك غالبًا؟
why (ar): النمط كلاسيكي لهجوم القوة الغاشمة أو حشو بيانات الاعتماد.

question (en): Which detection error is more dangerous?
right answer (en): False negative: an attack with no alert
wrong 1: False positive: an alert with no attack behind it
wrong 2: Both are equally harmless if logs are kept
wrong 3: Duplicate alerts for the same event
why (en): An unseen attack continues with no response at all.
question (ar): أي الخطأين أخطر في الكشف؟
why (ar): الهجوم غير المرصود يستمر بلا أي استجابة.

question (en): What does a SIEM do?
right answer (en): Collects logs from every source and correlates events
wrong 1: Blocks viruses on every laptop in the company
wrong 2: Encrypts email between staff and customers
wrong 3: Stores and rotates passwords for admin accounts
why (en): Correlating scattered events reveals what no single log shows.
question (ar): ما الذي يفعله نظام SIEM؟
right answer (ar): يجمع السجلات من كل المصادر ويربط الأحداث
why (ar): الربط بين أحداث متفرقة يكشف ما لا يظهر في سجل واحد.

question (en): What is an indicator of compromise (IoC)?
right answer (en): A technical trace of an attack, such as an IP or malware hash
wrong 1: A policy that sets password length and complexity rules
wrong 2: A quarterly report on what the company spent on security
wrong 3: A certificate that proves a website is the genuine one
why (en): IoCs are fed into detection tools to spot the same attack in your environment.
question (ar): ما مؤشر الاختراق (IoC)؟
right answer (ar): أثر تقني لهجوم مثل عنوان IP أو بصمة ملف خبيث
why (ar): تُضاف المؤشرات إلى أدوات الكشف لرصد الهجوم نفسه عندك.

question (en): Analysts ignore alerts because there are too many. What helps most?
right answer (en): Tune rules, add context and automate
wrong 1: Turn off the noisiest alert sources
wrong 2: Hire one more analyst for the night shift
wrong 3: Delete logs older than one week
why (en): A useful alert is rare, accurate and carries its context.
question (ar): المحللون يتجاهلون التنبيهات لكثرتها. ما الحل الأنسب؟
why (ar): التنبيه المفيد قليل ودقيق ويحمل سياقه.

question (en): What is threat hunting?
right answer (en): A proactive search for an undetected attacker
wrong 1: Waiting for the SIEM to raise a new alert
wrong 2: Buying the newest detection tools each year
wrong 3: An external penetration test of the website
why (en): The hunter assumes a breach and looks for its traces.
question (ar): ما صيد التهديدات؟
right answer (ar): بحث استباقي عن مهاجم لم يُكتشف بعد
why (ar): يفترض الصائد أن الاختراق وقع ويبحث عن آثاره.

question (en): What is the first phase of the NIST incident response cycle?
right answer (en): Preparation
wrong 1: Containment
wrong 2: Eradication
wrong 3: Recovery
why (en): The plan, team and tools must exist before the incident.
question (ar): ما أول مرحلة في دورة الاستجابة للحوادث حسب NIST؟
why (ar): الخطة والفريق والأدوات يجب أن تكون جاهزة قبل الحادثة.

question (en): You find a laptop infected with ransomware. What is the right first action?
right answer (en): Isolate it from the network without powering it off
wrong 1: Shut it down at once to stop the encryption
wrong 2: Reinstall the operating system right away
wrong 3: Leave it running so users can keep working
why (en): Isolation stops the spread; keeping it on preserves memory evidence.
question (ar): اكتشفت جهازًا مصابًا ببرنامج فدية. ما الإجراء الصحيح أولًا؟
why (ar): العزل يوقف الانتشار، وإبقاؤه يعمل يحفظ أدلة الذاكرة.

question (en): What is the right order for collecting evidence?
right answer (en): Most volatile first: memory first
wrong 1: Disks first, because they hold the most data
wrong 2: The oldest logs first, then work forwards
wrong 3: Order does not matter if you take copies
why (en): Memory contents vanish on shutdown or reboot.
question (ar): ما ترتيب جمع الأدلة الصحيح؟
right answer (ar): من الأكثر تبخرًا إلى الأقل: الذاكرة أولًا
why (ar): محتوى الذاكرة يضيع عند الإطفاء أو إعادة التشغيل.

question (en): Why hash the forensic disk image?
right answer (en): To prove the evidence hasn't changed
wrong 1: To encrypt the evidence for the court
wrong 2: To shrink the image so it is easier to store
wrong 3: To make the analysis tools run faster
why (en): Any change, even one bit, changes the hash.
question (ar): لماذا تحسب بصمة (hash) لنسخة القرص الجنائية؟
why (ar): أي تغيير ولو بت واحد يغيّر البصمة.

question (en): What is chain of custody?
right answer (en): A record of who handled evidence, when and what they did
wrong 1: A list of every machine the malware infected
wrong 2: The order in which the response phases happen
wrong 3: The email thread the attacker used to get in
why (en): Without it the evidence can be challenged in a legal setting.
question (ar): ما «سلسلة الحيازة»؟
right answer (ar): توثيق من تعامل مع الدليل ومتى وماذا فعل
why (ar): بدونها يمكن الطعن في صحة الدليل أمام جهة قانونية.

question (en): What is the spirit of a post-incident review?
right answer (en): Blameless, focused on improving systems
wrong 1: Finding someone to punish
wrong 2: Hiding it from management
wrong 3: Closing the case as fast as possible
why (en): Blame makes people hide mistakes, so incidents repeat.
question (ar): ما روح مراجعة ما بعد الحادثة؟
right answer (ar): بلا لوم وتركز على تحسين الأنظمة
why (ar): اللوم يجعل الناس يخفون الأخطاء، فتتكرر الحوادث.

question (en): Who is responsible for user permissions inside your cloud account?
right answer (en): You, the customer
wrong 1: The cloud provider
wrong 2: Nobody
wrong 3: Your internet provider
why (en): Identities and permissions are part of security in the cloud, which is yours.
question (ar): من المسؤول عن صلاحيات المستخدمين داخل حسابك السحابي؟
why (ar): الهويات والصلاحيات جزء من «أمنك داخل السحابة».

question (en): What is the most common cause of cloud incidents?
right answer (en): Customer misconfiguration
wrong 1: Provider data centres being breached
wrong 2: Natural disasters
wrong 3: Power cuts
why (en): Open buckets and broad permissions top the list of leak causes.
question (ar): ما السبب الأكثر شيوعًا لحوادث السحابة؟
why (ar): حاويات مفتوحة وصلاحيات واسعة تتصدر أسباب التسريب.

question (en): What is the better alternative to long-lived static access keys?
right answer (en): Roles with temporary credentials
wrong 1: Putting keys in the README
wrong 2: One shared key for the whole team
wrong 3: Longer keys
why (en): Temporary credentials expire automatically, so a leak does less harm.
question (ar): ما البديل الأفضل لمفاتيح الوصول الثابتة طويلة الأمد؟
why (ar): البيانات المؤقتة تنتهي صلاحيتها تلقائيًا، فتسريبها أقل ضررًا.

question (en): What does "shift left" mean?
right answer (en): Building security checks in early in development
wrong 1: Moving servers to another region
wrong 2: Postponing security until after launch
wrong 3: Writing code left to right
why (en): Timelines run left to right, and the start is the cheapest place to fix flaws.
question (ar): ماذا يعني «نقل الأمان إلى اليسار» Shift left؟
right answer (ar): دمج فحوص الأمان مبكرًا في التطوير
why (ar): خط الزمن يُرسم من اليسار، والبداية أرخص مكان لإصلاح الأخطاء.

question (en): What is a software bill of materials (SBOM)?
right answer (en): A list of every component and library in the software and its version
wrong 1: The invoice listing every software licence the company bought
wrong 2: A diagram of the database tables, keys and relationships
wrong 3: A plan describing the tests to run before each release
why (en): When a library flaw appears you know at once which systems are affected.
question (ar): ما قائمة مكونات البرمجيات (SBOM)؟
right answer (ar): قائمة بكل المكونات والمكتبات في البرنامج وإصداراتها
why (ar): عند ظهور ثغرة في مكتبة تعرف فورًا أي أنظمتك تتأثر.

question (en): Which scan tests the application while it runs?
right answer (en): DAST
wrong 1: SAST
wrong 2: SCA
wrong 3: SBOM
why (en): Dynamic testing sends real requests to the app and watches the responses.
question (ar): أي فحص يختبر التطبيق وهو يعمل؟
why (ar): الفحص الديناميكي يرسل طلبات حقيقية للتطبيق ويراقب الاستجابات.

question (en): What is the difference between a policy and a standard?
right answer (en): A policy says what; a standard says exactly how
wrong 1: A policy is for managers; a standard is for customers
wrong 2: A standard always outranks and replaces the policy
wrong 3: A policy is a legal contract; a standard is optional
why (en): For example, "encrypt sensitive data" is policy; "AES-256" is the standard.
question (ar): ما الفرق بين السياسة والمعيار؟
why (ar): مثلًا: «شفّر البيانات الحساسة» سياسة، و«AES-256» معيار.

question (en): What are the six functions of NIST CSF 2.0?
right answer (en): Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover
wrong 1: Plan, Build, Test, Deploy, Monitor, Close
wrong 2: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, AuthN, AuthZ, Audit
wrong 3: Analyse, Design, Implement, Operate, Maintain, Replace
why (en): Govern was added in version 2.0 in 2024.
question (ar): ما الوظائف الست في إطار NIST CSF 2.0؟
right answer (ar): الحوكمة، التحديد، الحماية، الكشف، الاستجابة، التعافي
why (ar): أضيفت وظيفة الحوكمة في الإصدار 2.0 عام 2024.

question (en): Which body issued Saudi Arabia's Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC)?
right answer (en): The National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA)
wrong 1: The Saudi Central Bank (SAMA)
wrong 2: The US National Institute of Standards (NIST)
wrong 3: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO)
why (en): The controls apply to government bodies and critical infrastructure.
question (ar): ما الجهة التي أصدرت الضوابط الأساسية للأمن السيبراني (ECC) في السعودية؟
why (ar): الضوابط تلزم الجهات الحكومية والبنية التحتية الحساسة.

question (en): The company can lose at most one hour of data. Which measure is this?
right answer (en): RPO (recovery point objective)
wrong 1: RTO (recovery time objective)
wrong 2: MTTR
wrong 3: SLA
why (en): RPO sets how old the last acceptable copy may be, and so how often you back up.
question (ar): الشركة تتحمل خسارة بيانات ساعة واحدة على الأكثر. أي مقياس هذا؟
why (ar): RPO يحدد عمر آخر نسخة مقبولة، وبالتالي تكرار النسخ الاحتياطي.

question (en): What does a risk register contain?
right answer (en): Risks, likelihood, impact, decision and owner
wrong 1: Every system's admin passwords
wrong 2: The staff list with each person's salary
wrong 3: The firewall logs for the last month
why (en): The register is a living management tool reviewed regularly.
question (ar): ما الذي يحتويه سجل المخاطر؟
why (ar): السجل أداة إدارة حية تُراجع دوريًا.

question (en): What is the Multi-Level Protection Scheme (等级保护)?
right answer (en): China's scheme grading systems by importance with controls per level
wrong 1: A European regulation on how cloud providers store personal data
wrong 2: An antivirus product that Chinese companies must install by law
wrong 3: A national encryption algorithm used by Chinese government systems
why (en): Companies operating in China usually need to comply with it.
question (ar): ما نظام «الحماية المتدرجة» 等级保护؟
right answer (ar): نظام صيني يصنّف الأنظمة حسب أهميتها ويحدد ضوابط كل مستوى
why (ar): الشركات العاملة في الصين تحتاج غالبًا إلى الامتثال له.

question (en): What makes a penetration test legal?
right answer (en): Written permission with a defined scope
wrong 1: Good intentions and a plan to help the company
wrong 2: Making sure nothing gets damaged during testing
wrong 3: Telling the company about it once you finish
why (en): Without written permission the test is unauthorised access.
question (ar): ما الذي يجعل اختبار الاختراق قانونيًا؟
why (ar): بدون إذن مكتوب يُعد الاختبار وصولًا غير مشروع.

question (en): During a test you find an interesting server outside the agreed scope. What do you do?
right answer (en): Stop, tell the client and ask for a written scope change
wrong 1: Test it quickly, because it may be important
wrong 2: Test it but leave it out of the report
wrong 3: Mention it on social media to warn others
why (en): Scope is a legal boundary that doesn't change verbally.
question (ar): وجدت أثناء الاختبار خادمًا مثيرًا للاهتمام خارج النطاق المتفق عليه. ماذا تفعل؟
right answer (ar): تتوقف وتبلغ العميل وتطلب توسيع النطاق كتابيًا
why (ar): النطاق حدّ قانوني لا يتغير شفهيًا.

question (en): A vulnerability scores 9.8 on CVSS. How is it rated?
right answer (en): Critical
wrong 1: Low
wrong 2: Medium
wrong 3: Informational
why (en): 9.0 to 10 is critical.
question (ar): ثغرة درجتها 9.8 في CVSS. ما تصنيفها؟
why (ar): 9.0 إلى 10 تصنيف حرج.

question (en): Which part of a test report matters most to executives?
right answer (en): The executive summary in business language
wrong 1: The full list of tools and versions used
wrong 2: The raw output from every scanner
wrong 3: The hours each tester worked
why (en): Executives need impact and priorities, not technical detail.
question (ar): ما أهم جزء لقارئ الإدارة في تقرير الاختبار؟
why (ar): الإدارة تحتاج الأثر والأولويات لا التفاصيل التقنية.

question (en): What is responsible disclosure?
right answer (en): Reporting privately to the vendor and allowing time to fix before publishing
wrong 1: Posting the flaw on social media at once so users can protect themselves
wrong 2: Selling the details to a broker who pays more than the bounty
wrong 3: Keeping it secret and never telling the vendor or anyone else
why (en): It protects users and gives the vendor a fair chance.
question (ar): ما الإفصاح المسؤول؟
right answer (ar): إبلاغ المصنّع سرًا ومنحه وقتًا للإصلاح قبل النشر
why (ar): يحمي المستخدمين ويمنح المصنّع فرصة عادلة.

question (en): What does a red team do?
right answer (en): Emulates a real attacker to test detection and response
wrong 1: Writes and approves the company's security policies
wrong 2: Runs the firewall and VPN configuration day to day
wrong 3: Audits the security team's budget and spending
why (en): The blue team defends; the red team tests that defence.
question (ar): ما دور الفريق الأحمر؟
right answer (ar): يحاكي مهاجمًا حقيقيًا لاختبار الكشف والاستجابة
why (ar): الفريق الأزرق يدافع، والأحمر يختبر دفاعه.

question (en): What does `0.1 + 0.2 === 0.3` give in JavaScript?

wrong 1: true
wrong 2: undefined
wrong 3: NaN

why (ar): الأعداد العشرية تُخزَّن بتقريب ثنائي، فالمجموع 0.30000000000000004.

question (en): A loop starts at `i = 0` with the condition `i <= arr.length`. What is wrong?
right answer (en): It reads one item past the end of the array
wrong 1: It skips the first item of the array
wrong 2: It stops one item before the last one

why (en): The last valid index is `arr.length - 1`; this is the off-by-one error.

why (ar): آخر فهرس صالح هو `arr.length - 1`، وهذا خطأ «الفرق بواحد».

question (en): A variable is declared with `let` inside an `if`. Can you use it after the block?
right answer (en): No, its scope is only the block
wrong 1: Yes, anywhere in the file
wrong 2: Yes, anywhere in the function
wrong 3: Only if it is a number
why (en): `let` and `const` are limited to the block they are declared in.
question (ar): متغير عُرّف بـ`let` داخل `if`. هل يمكن استخدامه بعد الكتلة؟
why (ar): `let` و`const` محصوران في الكتلة التي عُرّفا فيها.

question (en): What does `"5" + 3` give in JavaScript?
wrong 3: NaN
why (en): When one side is a string, `+` joins strings.

why (ar): حين يكون أحد الطرفين نصًا، يصبح `+` دمجًا للنصوص.

question (en): What does a function with no `return` give back?
right answer (en): undefined
wrong 1: null
wrong 3: false
why (en): Every function without an explicit `return` returns `undefined`.
question (ar): ماذا تُرجع الدالة التي لا تحتوي على `return`؟
why (ar): كل دالة بلا `return` صريح تُرجع `undefined`.

question (en): What does `break` do inside a loop?
right answer (en): Leaves the loop immediately
wrong 1: Skips only the current round
wrong 2: Restarts the loop from the beginning
wrong 3: Stops the whole program
why (en): `continue` skips the current round; `break` ends the loop.
question (ar): ما فائدة `break` داخل حلقة؟
why (ar): `continue` يتخطى التكرار الحالي، أما `break` فينهي الحلقة.

question (en): What is the clearest way to choose between two values in one line?
right answer (en): The ternary operator `cond ? a : b`
wrong 1: A `for` loop that checks both values
wrong 2: The `typeof` operator on each value
wrong 3: A `switch` statement with one case
why (en): The ternary returns `a` when the condition holds and `b` otherwise.
question (ar): ما الطريقة الأوضح لاختيار بين قيمتين في سطر واحد؟
why (ar): العامل الثلاثي يُرجع `a` إذا تحقق الشرط و`b` إن لم يتحقق.

question (en): What does it mean that a value is immutable?
right answer (en): It cannot be changed after it is created
wrong 1: It can be read only once, then it is gone
wrong 2: It is copied every time you pass it around
wrong 3: Its type is fixed but its content can change
why (en): Strings in JavaScript, for example, are immutable: every change creates a new string.
question (ar): ما معنى أن القيمة «غير قابلة للتغيير» (immutable)؟
why (ar): النصوص في جافاسكربت مثلًا غير قابلة للتغيير: كل تعديل ينشئ نصًا جديدًا.

question (en): Which is the best name for a variable holding the number of active users?
right answer (en): activeUserCount
wrong 1: x
wrong 2: data2
wrong 3: temp
why (en): A good name explains the meaning without needing a comment.
question (ar): ما أفضل اسم لمتغير يحمل عدد المستخدمين النشطين؟
why (ar): الاسم الجيد يشرح المعنى دون الحاجة إلى تعليق.

question (en): What does `[1, 2, 3].map(n => n * 2)` return?
why (en): `map` applies the function to every item and returns a new array of the same length.
why (ar): `map` تطبّق الدالة على كل عنصر وتُرجع مصفوفة جديدة بالطول نفسه.

question (en): Which structure keeps values without duplicates and quickly answers "is this here?"
right answer (en): Set
wrong 1: Array
wrong 2: Stack
wrong 3: Queue
why (en): A Set is hash-based, so `has` costs O(1) on average.
question (ar): أي بنية تحفظ القيم دون تكرار وتجيب بسرعة عن «هل هذا موجود؟»
why (ar): المجموعة تعتمد على التجزئة، فالسؤال `has` يكلّف O(1) في المتوسط.

question (en): An emergency system always handles the most serious case first. Which structure fits?
right answer (en): A priority queue (heap)
wrong 1: A stack
wrong 2: An unsorted array
wrong 3: A singly linked list
why (en): A heap gives you the highest-priority item in O(log n) per insert and remove.
question (ar): نظام طوارئ يعالج دائمًا الحالة الأكثر خطورة أولًا. أي بنية تناسبه؟
why (ar): الكومة تعطيك العنصر الأعلى أولوية في O(log n) لكل إضافة وإزالة.

question (en): What does adding an item at the start of a large array cost?
right answer (en): O(n)
wrong 2: O(log n)
wrong 3: O(n²)
why (en): Every other item has to shift by one place.
question (ar): ما تكلفة إضافة عنصر في بداية مصفوفة كبيرة؟
why (ar): يجب إزاحة كل العناصر الأخرى خطوة واحدة.

question (en): What is a collision in a hash table?
right answer (en): Two different keys land in the same slot
wrong 1: One key is stored twice by mistake
wrong 2: The table runs out of memory
wrong 3: An item is deleted by another key
why (en): Tables handle collisions with chains or by probing another slot; too many slow them down.
question (ar): ما «التصادم» في جدول التجزئة؟
why (ar): الجداول تعالج التصادم بسلاسل أو بالبحث عن موضع آخر؛ الكثير منه يبطئها.

question (en): What is the difference between a tree and a graph?
right answer (en): A tree is a graph with no cycles and one root
wrong 1: A tree is always faster to search
wrong 2: A graph can never have cycles
wrong 3: A tree must have at most two children
why (en): Every tree is a graph, but not every graph is a tree.
question (ar): ما الفرق بين الشجرة والرسم البياني (graph)؟

why (ar): كل شجرة رسم بياني، لكن ليس كل رسم بياني شجرة.

question (en): Which structure models a road network between cities with distances?
right answer (en): A weighted graph
wrong 1: A stack of the cities in order
wrong 2: A set of the city names
wrong 3: A binary tree sorted by city name
why (en): Cities are nodes and roads are edges weighted by distance.
question (ar): أي بنية تصف شبكة طرق بين مدن مع المسافات؟
why (ar): المدن عُقد والطرق حواف وزنها المسافة.

question (en): What makes a binary search tree slow?
right answer (en): Inserting values in sorted order so it becomes a list
wrong 1: Storing a very large number of different values
wrong 2: Using negative numbers or strings as the keys
wrong 3: Reading from the root node on every search
why (en): Without balancing its height becomes n and search O(n); that is why balanced trees are used.
question (ar): ما الذي يجعل شجرة البحث الثنائية بطيئة؟
why (ar): بلا توازن يصبح ارتفاعها n والبحث O(n)؛ لذلك نستخدم أشجارًا متوازنة.

question (en): Which structure do browsers use for the back and forward buttons?
right answer (en): Two stacks
wrong 1: One queue
wrong 2: A hash table
wrong 3: A tree
why (en): Back pops from one stack and pushes onto the forward stack.
question (ar): أي بنية تستخدمها المتصفحات لأزرار «رجوع» و«تقدّم»؟
why (ar): زر الرجوع يسحب من مكدس ويدفع إلى مكدس التقدّم.

question (en): What does searching for a value in an unsorted array cost?
right answer (en): O(n)
wrong 2: O(log n)
wrong 3: O(n log n)
why (en): Without order you must check the items one by one.
question (ar): ما تكلفة البحث عن قيمة في مصفوفة غير مرتبة؟
why (ar): بلا ترتيب لا بد من فحص العناصر واحدًا واحدًا.

question (en): In JavaScript, why prefer `Map` over a plain object for a big lookup table?
right answer (en): It accepts any key type and keeps insertion order
wrong 1: It uses no memory at all for its keys
wrong 2: It sorts its keys alphabetically by itself
wrong 3: It is slower than objects, so it is safer
why (en): `Map` is built for lookups: keys of any type, a `size`, and steady performance with frequent adds and deletes.

question (en): What is merge sort's worst-case complexity?
right answer (en): O(n log n)

wrong 2: O(n)
wrong 3: O(log n)
why (en): It halves the list log n times and merges each level in O(n).

why (ar): يقسم القائمة نصفين log n مرة ويدمج كل مستوى في O(n).

question (en): What is the fastest way to find two numbers that add up to a target?

wrong 1: Trying every pair
wrong 2: Sorting and then trying every pair
wrong 3: Random search
why (en): One pass with a Map gives O(n) instead of O(n²).
question (ar): ما الحل الأسرع لإيجاد عددين مجموعهما هدف معيّن؟
right answer (ar): حفظ الأعداد المرئية في جدول تجزئة
why (ar): مرور واحد مع Map يعطي O(n) بدل O(n²).

question (en): What is a greedy algorithm?
right answer (en): It takes the best local choice at each step
wrong 1: It tries every option and keeps the best one
wrong 2: It solves each subproblem once and stores it
wrong 3: It splits the input in half at every step
why (en): It works when the local best leads to the global best, like giving change with the largest coins first.
question (ar): ما الخوارزمية الجشعة (greedy)؟
right answer (ar): تأخذ أفضل خيار محلي في كل خطوة
why (ar): تنجح حين يقود الأفضل محليًا إلى الأفضل كليًا، مثل إعطاء الباقي بأكبر العملات أولًا.

question (en): What is the complexity of reading an array item by its index?
wrong 1: O(n)
wrong 2: O(log n)
wrong 3: O(n log n)
why (en): The address is computed directly from the start of the array and the index.
question (ar): ما تعقيد الوصول إلى عنصر في مصفوفة بفهرسه؟
why (ar): العنوان يُحسب مباشرة من بداية المصفوفة والفهرس.

question (en): A function calls itself twice for each n, like naive Fibonacci. Roughly what is its complexity?
right answer (en): O(2ⁿ)
wrong 1: O(n)
wrong 2: O(log n)
wrong 3: O(n²)
why (en): Every call branches into two; memoization brings it back to O(n).
question (ar): دالة تستدعي نفسها مرتين لكل n مثل فيبوناتشي البسيطة. ما تعقيدها تقريبًا؟
why (ar): كل استدعاء يتفرع إلى اثنين؛ الحفظ (memoization) يعيده إلى O(n).

question (en): What is memoization?
right answer (en): Saving each call's result to reuse it
wrong 1: Clearing memory after each call to save space
wrong 2: Sorting the inputs before calling the function
wrong 3: Running each call on a separate machine
why (en): Computing each case only once is the heart of dynamic programming.
question (ar): ما «التخزين المؤقت للنتائج» (memoization)؟
right answer (ar): حفظ نتيجة كل استدعاء لإعادة استخدامها
why (ar): حساب كل حالة مرة واحدة فقط هو جوهر البرمجة الديناميكية.

question (en): Which sorting algorithm is very slow on big lists?
right answer (en): Bubble sort
wrong 1: Merge sort
wrong 2: Quick sort on average
wrong 3: The library's built-in sort
why (en): Bubble sort is O(n²); use the library sort in real work.
question (ar): أي خوارزمية ترتيب بطيئة جدًا على القوائم الكبيرة؟
why (ar): ترتيب الفقاعة O(n²)؛ استخدم ترتيب المكتبة في العمل الحقيقي.

question (en): What does space complexity measure?
right answer (en): How much extra memory the algorithm needs
wrong 1: The size of the source file that holds the code
wrong 2: How many lines the main function contains
wrong 3: How fast the data moves across the network
why (en): It is measured like time: how it grows with the input size n.
question (ar): ما الذي يقيسه «تعقيد المساحة» (space complexity)؟
right answer (ar): كمية الذاكرة الإضافية التي تحتاجها الخوارزمية
why (ar): يقاس كما يقاس الوقت: كيف يكبر مع حجم المُدخل n.

question (en): Which order of complexities is correct from fastest to slowest?
right answer (en): O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n²)
wrong 1: O(n) < O(1) < O(n²) < O(log n)
wrong 2: O(log n) < O(1) < O(n²) < O(n)
wrong 3: O(n²) < O(n) < O(log n) < O(1)
why (en): Constant is fastest, then logarithmic, then linear, then quadratic.
question (ar): أي ترتيب للتعقيد صحيح من الأسرع إلى الأبطأ؟
why (ar): الثابت أسرع ثم اللوغاريتمي ثم الخطي ثم التربيعي.

question (en): What does `[10, 9, 1].sort((a, b) => a - b)` return?

question (ar): ما ناتج `[10, 9, 1].sort((a, b) => a - b)`؟
why (ar): دالة المقارنة تجعل الترتيب رقميًا بدل الترتيب النصي الافتراضي.

question (en): What is abstraction?
right answer (en): Showing what an object does and hiding how
wrong 1: Copying code from one class to another
wrong 2: Deleting classes that are never used
wrong 3: Making every field public for easy use
why (en): Abstraction lets you use an object without knowing its inner details.
question (ar): ما التجريد (abstraction)؟
right answer (ar): إظهار ما يفعله الكائن وإخفاء كيف يفعله
why (ar): التجريد يسمح لك باستخدام الكائن دون معرفة تفاصيله الداخلية.

question (en): What is an interface?
right answer (en): A contract listing the methods a class must provide
wrong 1: A base class holding the shared code for others
wrong 2: A screen the user clicks to control objects
wrong 3: A table that stores each object's fields
why (en): An interface holds no implementation, only the promise.
question (ar): ما الواجهة (interface)؟
right answer (ar): عقد يحدد الدوال التي يجب أن يقدّمها الصنف
why (ar): الواجهة لا تحتوي على تنفيذ، بل على الوعد فقط.

question (en): Which SOLID principle says "depend on abstractions, not details"?
right answer (en): Dependency inversion (D)
wrong 1: Single responsibility (S)
wrong 2: Substitution (L)
wrong 3: Interface segregation (I)
why (en): High- and low-level modules both depend on a shared interface.
question (ar): أي مبدأ في SOLID يقول «اعتمد على التجريد لا على التفاصيل»؟
why (ar): الوحدات العليا والدنيا تعتمدان معًا على واجهة مشتركة.

question (en): What is the open/closed principle (O)?
right answer (en): You add new behaviour without changing existing code
wrong 1: Every class must be public to everyone
wrong 2: Files are closed for reading after release
wrong 3: You never write new classes after launch
why (en): For example, adding a new payment method as a new class instead of another `if` everywhere.
question (ar): ما مبدأ «مفتوح للإضافة، مغلق للتعديل» (O)؟
right answer (ar): تضيف سلوكًا جديدًا دون تعديل الكود القائم
why (ar): مثلًا إضافة طريقة دفع جديدة بصنف جديد بدل `if` إضافية في كل مكان.

question (en): `Square` inherits from `Rectangle` and breaks its behaviour when you change the width. Which principle is broken?
right answer (en): Liskov substitution (L)
wrong 1: Single responsibility (S)
wrong 2: Interface segregation (I)
wrong 3: Dependency inversion (D)
why (en): A child class must work anywhere the parent works, without surprises.
question (ar): صنف `Square` يرث من `Rectangle` ويكسر سلوكه حين تغيّر العرض. أي مبدأ انتُهك؟
why (ar): يجب أن يعمل الصنف الابن في أي مكان يعمل فيه الأب دون مفاجآت.

question (en): A huge interface forces classes to implement methods they do not need. What fixes it?
right answer (en): Splitting it into small interfaces
wrong 1: Adding default bodies to every method
wrong 2: Turning it into one abstract class
wrong 3: Removing all interfaces from the code
why (en): This is interface segregation (I).
question (ar): واجهة كبيرة تجبر الأصناف على تنفيذ دوال لا تحتاجها. ما الحل؟
why (ar): هذا مبدأ فصل الواجهات (I).

question (en): What is an object?
right answer (en): An instance of a class with its own state and behaviour
wrong 1: A blueprint describing what fields a class has
wrong 2: A function with no name passed to another one
wrong 3: A file that stores the data of one class
why (en): The class is the template; the object is what is made from it.
question (ar): ما الكائن (object)؟
right answer (ar): نسخة من صنف لها حالتها وسلوكها
why (ar): الصنف هو القالب والكائن هو ما يُصنع منه.

question (en): What is a constructor?
right answer (en): A method that sets up a new object when it is created
wrong 1: A method that removes the object from memory
wrong 2: A tool that compiles and builds the app
wrong 3: A test that checks new objects
why (en): In JavaScript it is called `constructor` and runs with `new`.
question (ar): ما «المُنشئ» (constructor)؟

why (ar): في جافاسكربت اسمها `constructor` وتُستدعى مع `new`.

question (en): What is a static method?
right answer (en): A method that belongs to the class itself, not to an object
wrong 1: A method whose code can never be overridden
wrong 2: A method that only the class's own code may call
wrong 3: A method that runs once when the app starts
why (en): It is called like `Math.max()` without creating an object.
question (ar): ما «الدالة الثابتة» (static method)؟
right answer (ar): دالة تنتمي إلى الصنف نفسه لا إلى كائن منه
why (ar): تُستدعى هكذا `Math.max()` دون إنشاء كائن.

question (en): When is inheritance a good choice?
right answer (en): When the relationship really is "is a kind of"
wrong 1: Always, to reduce code
wrong 2: Whenever two classes share one method
wrong 3: When you want a faster program
why (en): A cat is a kind of animal; merely sharing behaviour is better done with composition.
question (ar): متى تكون الوراثة اختيارًا جيدًا؟

why (ar): القطة نوع من الحيوان؛ أما مشاركة سلوك فقط فتكون بالتركيب.

question (en): Which pattern adds behaviour to an object without changing its class?
right answer (en): Decorator

wrong 2: Singleton
wrong 3: Observer
why (en): A decorator wraps the original object and adds around it.
question (ar): أي نمط يضيف سلوكًا إلى كائن دون تعديل صنفه؟

question (en): An editor's undo button is usually built on which pattern?

wrong 1: Adapter
wrong 2: Singleton
wrong 3: Factory
why (en): Each action is an object that knows how to run and how to reverse itself.
question (ar): زر «تراجع» في محرر نصوص يُبنى عادة على أي نمط؟
why (ar): كل فعل كائن يعرف كيف يُنفَّذ وكيف يُلغى.

question (en): What is the facade pattern?
right answer (en): One simple door into a complex subsystem
wrong 1: One single instance of a class
wrong 2: Converting one interface to another
wrong 3: Notifying subscribers of a change
why (en): Like a `checkout()` function hiding stock, payment and shipping behind it.
question (ar): ما نمط الواجهة المبسّطة (facade)؟
right answer (ar): باب بسيط واحد لنظام فرعي معقد
why (ar): مثل دالة `checkout()` التي تخفي المخزون والدفع والشحن خلفها.

question (en): What is middleware in a web server?

wrong 2: The front-end code that builds the page in the browser
wrong 3: A library that renders the server's HTML templates
why (en): Such as checking identity or logging requests; each layer passes the request on.
question (ar): ما الوسيط (middleware) في خادم ويب؟
right answer (ar): طبقة تعالج الطلب قبل وصوله إلى المعالج النهائي
why (ar): مثل التحقق من الهوية أو تسجيل الطلبات، كل طبقة تمرّر الطلب للتالية.

question (en): What is an anti-pattern?
right answer (en): A common solution that looks useful but causes problems
wrong 1: A pattern that reverses the order of other patterns
wrong 2: A design pattern that only works in old languages
wrong 3: A test written to prove that a pattern fails
why (en): Like the "god object" that knows and does everything.
question (ar): ما «النمط المضاد» (anti-pattern)؟
right answer (ar): حل شائع يبدو مفيدًا لكنه يسبب مشكلات
why (ar): مثل «الكائن الإله» الذي يعرف ويفعل كل شيء.

question (en): When should you not use a complex pattern?
right answer (en): When the problem it solves does not exist yet
wrong 1: Whenever the team has fewer than five people
wrong 2: In every new project from the start
wrong 3: Whenever the language is JavaScript
why (en): Complexity before it is needed makes code harder with no gain (the YAGNI principle).
question (ar): متى يجب ألا تستخدم نمطًا معقدًا؟
right answer (ar): حين لا توجد المشكلة التي يحلّها بعد
why (ar): التعقيد قبل الحاجة يجعل الكود أصعب دون فائدة (مبدأ YAGNI).

question (en): A system must create different notifications (email, SMS, push) depending on a setting. Which pattern fits?
right answer (en): Factory
wrong 1: Singleton
wrong 2: Decorator
wrong 3: Facade
why (en): The factory decides which class to create, so the rest of the code stays out of the details.
question (ar): نظام يحتاج إلى إنشاء أنواع مختلفة من الإشعارات (بريد، رسالة، تنبيه) حسب الإعداد. أي نمط يناسب؟
why (ar): المصنع يقرر أي صنف يُنشأ، فيبقى باقي الكود بعيدًا عن التفاصيل.

question (en): What does DRY mean?
right answer (en): Don't repeat yourself
wrong 1: Write tests first
wrong 2: Delete old code
wrong 3: Always use patterns
why (en): Every piece of knowledge in the system should live in one place.
question (ar): ما معنى DRY؟
why (ar): كل معرفة في النظام يجب أن يكون لها مكان واحد.

question (en): What is the difference between an adapter and a facade?
right answer (en): An adapter matches one interface to another; a facade simplifies a whole system
wrong 1: They are two names for the same structural pattern
wrong 2: An adapter adds caching; a facade adds logging to calls
wrong 3: A facade converts data formats; an adapter hides a subsystem
why (en): Both wrap, but the goal differs: compatibility versus simplicity.
question (ar): ما الفرق بين المحوّل (adapter) والواجهة المبسّطة (facade)؟
right answer (ar): المحوّل يطابق واجهة مع أخرى؛ الواجهة المبسّطة تُبسّط نظامًا كاملًا
why (ar): كلاهما يغلّف، لكن الهدف مختلف: التوافق مقابل البساطة.

question (en): What is a code smell?
right answer (en): A sign of a design problem that may need refactoring
wrong 1: An error that crashes the program at start-up
wrong 2: A comment that is longer than the code it explains
wrong 3: A warning from the compiler about unused imports
why (en): Such as very long functions, duplicated code or too many parameters.
question (ar): ما «رائحة الكود» (code smell)؟
right answer (ar): علامة على مشكلة تصميم قد تحتاج إعادة هيكلة
why (ar): مثل الدوال الطويلة جدًا أو الكود المكرر أو المعاملات الكثيرة.

question (en): What is the `.gitignore` file for?
right answer (en): It stops Git from tracking certain files
wrong 1: It deletes files from the repository
wrong 2: It hides branches from other people
wrong 3: It speeds up pushing to the server
why (en): Put `node_modules`, build output and secret files such as `.env` in it.
question (ar): ما وظيفة ملف `.gitignore`؟
right answer (ar): يمنع Git من تتبّع ملفات معيّنة
why (ar): ضع فيه `node_modules` وملفات البناء وملفات الأسرار مثل `.env`.

question (en): What does `git pull` do?
right answer (en): Fetches remote changes and merges them into your branch
wrong 1: Uploads your local commits to the remote branch
wrong 2: Downloads remote changes but leaves your branch as is
wrong 3: Creates a new local branch from the remote one
why (en): `pull` = `fetch` then `merge` (or `rebase`, depending on settings).
question (ar): ماذا يفعل `git pull`؟
right answer (ar): يجلب التغييرات من البعيد ويدمجها في فرعك
why (ar): `pull` = `fetch` ثم `merge` (أو `rebase` حسب الإعداد).

question (en): What is the difference between `git fetch` and `git pull`?
right answer (en): `fetch` only downloads; `pull` downloads and merges
wrong 1: They do the same thing with different names
wrong 2: `fetch` uploads, `pull` downloads
wrong 3: `pull` only downloads, `fetch` also merges
why (en): `fetch` is safe for seeing what changed before merging.
question (ar): ما الفرق بين `git fetch` و`git pull`؟
why (ar): `fetch` آمن للاطلاع على ما تغيّر قبل الدمج.

question (en): Which command shows the commit history?
right answer (en): git log
wrong 1: git status
wrong 2: git add
wrong 3: git init
why (en): `git log --oneline` shows it in short form.
question (ar): أي أمر يعرض تاريخ الالتزامات؟
why (ar): `git log --oneline` يعرضه مختصرًا.

question (en): What does `git status` show?
right answer (en): Modified, staged and untracked files
wrong 1: The whole history of the repository
wrong 2: The speed of the remote server
wrong 3: The names of everyone who contributed
why (en): The first command to type when you are not sure where you stand.
question (ar): ما الذي يعرضه `git status`؟
why (ar): أول أمر تكتبه حين لا تعرف أين أنت.

question (en): What is the staging area?
right answer (en): Where you gather changes before committing
wrong 1: A copy of the repository kept on the server
wrong 2: The branch that is deployed to production
wrong 3: The bin that holds files you deleted
why (en): `git add` puts a change there; `git commit` saves what it holds.
question (ar): ما «منطقة التجهيز» (staging area)؟
right answer (ar): المكان الذي تجمع فيه التغييرات قبل الالتزام
why (ar): `git add` يضع التغيير فيها، و`git commit` يحفظ ما فيها.

question (en): What does `git rebase main` do to your branch?
right answer (en): Replays your commits on top of the latest main
wrong 1: Deletes main and keeps only your branch
wrong 2: Merges every other branch into yours
wrong 3: Pushes your branch to the remote server
why (en): It gives a straight history; do not rewrite a branch others already share.
question (ar): ما الذي يفعله `git rebase main` على فرعك؟
right answer (ar): يعيد تطبيق التزاماتك فوق آخر main
why (ar): يعطي تاريخًا مستقيمًا؛ لا تُعِد كتابة فرع شاركه الآخرون.

question (en): Why not use `git push --force` on a shared branch?
right answer (en): It can wipe out your teammates' commits
wrong 1: Because it is slow
wrong 2: Because it deletes the local repository
wrong 3: Because it never works
why (en): A force push replaces the remote history with yours.
question (ar): لماذا لا تستخدم `git push --force` على فرع مشترك؟
why (ar): الدفع بالقوة يستبدل التاريخ البعيد بتاريخك.

question (en): What is a tag in Git?
right answer (en): A fixed name pointing to one commit, such as a release
wrong 1: A temporary branch created for each new release
wrong 2: A comment attached to a file inside the repository
wrong 3: A setting that marks a branch as protected from push
why (en): Like `v1.2.0` to mark the version that was released.
question (ar): ما «الوسم» (tag) في Git؟
right answer (ar): اسم ثابت يشير إلى التزام معيّن مثل إصدار
why (ar): مثل `v1.2.0` لتعليم الإصدار الذي أُطلق.

question (en): Where should the reason for a change be written?
right answer (en): In the commit message
wrong 1: Only in the branch name
wrong 2: In a separate file on the desktop
wrong 3: It does not need writing
why (en): The first line sums up the change; the paragraph after it explains why.
question (ar): أين يُكتب سبب التغيير في الالتزام؟
why (ar): السطر الأول يلخّص التغيير، والفقرة بعده تشرح «لماذا».

question (en): What is a flaky test?
right answer (en): It passes sometimes and fails sometimes with no code change
wrong 1: A test that takes many minutes to finish on every run
wrong 2: A test that has no assertions, so it always passes
wrong 3: A test that covers only one very small helper function
why (en): Common causes are timing, ordering and outside services.
question (ar): ما «الاختبار المتقلّب» (flaky test)؟
right answer (ar): ينجح أحيانًا ويفشل أحيانًا دون تغيير في الكود
why (ar): أسبابه الشائعة التوقيت والترتيب والخدمات الخارجية.

question (en): Why use a mock in a unit test?
right answer (en): To isolate the code from the network and database and get a steady result
wrong 1: To run the test against the real network and the real database
wrong 2: To skip writing assertions and still have the test pass
wrong 3: To test the user interface instead of the business logic
why (en): The fake gives a known answer and lets you check how it was called.
question (ar): لماذا نستخدم بديلًا مزيّفًا (mock) في اختبار وحدة؟
right answer (ar): لعزل الكود عن الشبكة وقاعدة البيانات والحصول على نتيجة ثابتة
why (ar): البديل يعطي جوابًا معروفًا ويسمح بالتحقق من طريقة استدعائه.

question (en): What is an end-to-end test?
right answer (en): It drives the whole app the way people use it
wrong 1: It tests a single function on its own
wrong 2: It only measures how fast the code runs
wrong 3: It checks the code against formatting rules
why (en): Tools such as Playwright click and type in a real browser.
question (ar): ما اختبار الطرف إلى الطرف (E2E)؟
right answer (ar): يشغّل التطبيق كاملًا كما يستخدمه الناس
why (ar): أدوات مثل Playwright تنقر وتكتب في متصفح حقيقي.

question (en): What is an integration test?
right answer (en): It checks that several parts work together
wrong 1: It checks one line of code alone
wrong 2: The customer writes it after release
wrong 3: It only measures performance
why (en): Like a service really saving to a test database.
question (ar): ما اختبار التكامل (integration test)؟
right answer (ar): يتحقق من أن عدة أجزاء تعمل معًا
why (ar): مثل خدمة تحفظ فعلًا في قاعدة بيانات اختبارية.

question (en): What is an assertion in a test?
right answer (en): A statement that checks the result is what was expected
wrong 1: A comment explaining what the tested code does
wrong 2: The setup step that fills the test database
wrong 3: A label grouping several tests in one report
why (en): Like `expect(total).toBe(90)`; without an assertion the test checks nothing.
question (ar): ما «التأكيد» (assertion) في الاختبار؟
right answer (ar): عبارة تتحقق من أن النتيجة كما هو متوقع
why (ar): مثل `expect(total).toBe(90)`؛ بلا تأكيد لا يختبر الاختبار شيئًا.

question (en): What is a smoke test?
right answer (en): A quick check that the core features work after a deployment
wrong 1: A full security scan of the servers before release
wrong 2: A long test suite that runs through the night
wrong 3: A check that the new code follows the style guide
why (en): If it fails, there is no point in deeper tests before a fix.
question (ar): ما «الدخان» (smoke test)؟
right answer (ar): فحص سريع أن الوظائف الأساسية تعمل بعد النشر
why (ar): إذا فشل، لا داعي لاختبارات أعمق قبل الإصلاح.

question (en): What do you do when a user finds a bug?
right answer (en): Write a test that reproduces it, then fix it
wrong 1: Fix it quickly and skip the test this time
wrong 2: Remove the feature until next release
wrong 3: Wait until more users report it
why (en): The test stops the same bug from coming back later.
question (ar): ماذا تفعل حين يكتشف المستخدم خطأ؟
right answer (ar): تكتب اختبارًا يعيد إنتاجه ثم تصلحه
why (ar): الاختبار يمنع عودة الخطأ نفسه لاحقًا.

question (en): What is a load test for?
right answer (en): Seeing how the system behaves under many users
wrong 1: Checking spelling in the user interface
wrong 2: Checking the colours match the design
wrong 3: Cleaning out old rows in the database
why (en): It reveals bottlenecks before customers do.
question (ar): ما الهدف من اختبار الأداء (load test)؟
right answer (ar): معرفة سلوك النظام تحت عدد كبير من المستخدمين
why (ar): يكشف الاختناقات قبل أن يكتشفها العملاء.

question (en): Where should tests run automatically?
right answer (en): In the CI pipeline on every push
wrong 1: Only on the manager's computer
wrong 2: Once a year
wrong 3: In production in front of users
why (en): An early failure is far cheaper than one after release.
question (ar): أين يجب أن تعمل الاختبارات تلقائيًا؟
right answer (ar): في خط التكامل المستمر مع كل دفع
why (ar): الفشل المبكر أرخص بكثير من الفشل بعد الإطلاق.

question (en): A test depends on today's date and fails only on Saturdays. What is the fix?
right answer (en): Pass the time in as an input or freeze it in the test
wrong 1: Skip the test on Saturdays with a date check
wrong 2: Delete the test because it cannot be trusted
wrong 3: Give the test a much longer timeout to finish
why (en): Time is an outside dependency like the network: make it controllable.
question (ar): اختبار يعتمد على تاريخ اليوم فيفشل يوم السبت فقط. ما الحل؟
right answer (ar): تمرير الوقت كمُدخل أو تثبيته في الاختبار
why (ar): الوقت اعتماد خارجي مثل الشبكة: اجعله قابلًا للتحكم.

question (en): Where does an access token usually go in an API request?
right answer (en): In the Authorization header
wrong 1: In the page URL as a query value
wrong 2: In the name of the uploaded file
wrong 3: In the user's IP address field
why (en): URLs are saved in logs; headers usually are not.
question (ar): أين يوضع رمز الوصول (token) عادة في طلب API؟
why (ar): الروابط تُحفظ في السجلات، أما الترويسة فلا تظهر فيها عادة.

question (en): What does CORS control?
right answer (en): Which websites may read your API's responses from a browser
wrong 1: How quickly the server must answer every request
wrong 2: Which servers may connect to your database directly
wrong 3: Which passwords users are allowed to choose
why (en): CORS is a browser rule; tools such as curl ignore it.
question (ar): ما الذي يتحكم فيه CORS؟
right answer (ar): أي المواقع يحق لها قراءة ردود واجهتك من المتصفح
why (ar): CORS قاعدة متصفح؛ الأدوات مثل curl لا تلتزم بها.

question (en): What is the right way to return a million orders from an API?
right answer (en): Splitting them into pages (pagination)
wrong 1: Returning them all in one response
wrong 2: Compressing them into a single image
wrong 3: Emailing a file of them to the client
why (en): Pages protect the server and network and speed up the app.
question (ar): ما الطريقة الصحيحة لإرجاع مليون طلب من API؟
why (ar): الصفحات تحمي الخادم والشبكة وتسرّع التطبيق.

question (en): What does it mean that a PUT request is idempotent?
right answer (en): Repeating it gives the same result
wrong 1: It cannot be repeated
wrong 2: It creates a new item each time
wrong 3: It never changes anything
why (en): POST usually is not: repeating it may create two orders.
question (ar): ما معنى أن طلب PUT «متساوي القوة» (idempotent)؟
why (ar): POST عادة ليس كذلك: تكراره قد ينشئ طلبين.

question (en): What does status 404 mean?
right answer (en): The resource was not found
wrong 1: The server is down
wrong 2: You lack permission
wrong 3: The request succeeded
why (en): 4xx errors come from the request; 5xx errors come from the server.
question (ar): ماذا يعني الرمز 404؟
why (ar): الأخطاء من 400 إلى 499 سببها الطلب، ومن 500 فأعلى سببها الخادم.

question (en): What is the difference between 401 and 403?
right answer (en): 401: you are not authenticated; 403: you are known but not allowed
wrong 1: 401: the server crashed; 403: the request timed out
wrong 2: 401: the page moved; 403: the page was deleted
wrong 3: They mean the same thing; only the wording differs
why (en): Logging in fixes 401; only a new permission fixes 403.
question (ar): ما الفرق بين 401 و403؟
right answer (ar): 401: لم تثبت هويتك؛ 403: هويتك معروفة لكن بلا صلاحية
why (ar): سجّل الدخول لحل 401، أما 403 فلا يحلّها إلا صلاحية جديدة.

question (en): What is JSON?
right answer (en): A text format for exchanging data
wrong 1: A programming language for servers
wrong 2: A database for storing documents
wrong 3: A network protocol like HTTP
why (en): Objects, arrays, strings and numbers in a form both people and machines read.
question (ar): ما JSON؟
why (ar): كائنات ومصفوفات ونصوص وأعداد بصيغة يقرؤها البشر والآلات.

question (en): What does the header `Cache-Control: max-age=60` do?
right answer (en): Lets the response be reused for 60 seconds
wrong 1: Deletes the response from the server after 60 seconds
wrong 2: Delays the request by 60 seconds
wrong 3: Limits it to 60 users
why (en): Caching saves repeat requests to the server.
question (ar): ما الذي تفعله ترويسة `Cache-Control: max-age=60`؟
right answer (ar): تسمح بإعادة استخدام الرد لمدة 60 ثانية
why (ar): التخزين المؤقت يوفّر طلبات متكررة على الخادم.

question (en): What is a WebSocket?
right answer (en): An open two-way connection between browser and server
wrong 1: A cookie the browser sends with every page
wrong 2: A compressed image format for the web
wrong 3: A secure place to store passwords
why (en): It suits chat and live notifications instead of repeated polling.
question (ar): ما WebSocket؟
right answer (ar): اتصال مفتوح باتجاهين بين المتصفح والخادم
why (ar): مناسب للدردشة والإشعارات الفورية بدل السؤال المتكرر.

question (en): Why version an API with something like `/v1/`?
right answer (en): To change the API without breaking older apps
wrong 1: To make every request faster for the server to answer
wrong 2: To hide the API from users who don't know the path
wrong 3: Because the HTTP standard requires a version number
why (en): Apps installed on phones do not all update on the same day.
question (ar): لماذا يجب أن تُرقّم الواجهة بإصدار مثل `/v1/`؟
right answer (ar): لتغيير الواجهة دون كسر التطبيقات القديمة
why (ar): التطبيقات المثبّتة على الهواتف لا تتحدث كلها في اليوم نفسه.

question (en): What is normalisation?
right answer (en): Storing each fact in one place to avoid duplication
wrong 1: Compressing tables so they use less disk space
wrong 2: Copying every table into a separate backup
wrong 3: Removing indexes so that writes run faster
why (en): Duplication lets data disagree when only one copy is changed.
question (ar): ما التطبيع (normalisation)؟
right answer (ar): تخزين كل معلومة في مكان واحد لتجنب التكرار
why (ar): التكرار يجعل البيانات تتعارض حين يُعدَّل أحد النسخ فقط.

question (en): What is the N+1 query problem?
right answer (en): One query per item instead of one batched query
wrong 1: A table created with the wrong number of columns
wrong 2: A table that has no primary key defined
wrong 3: A backup that is missing one of the tables
why (en): 100 items = 101 queries; the fix is a JOIN or a batched fetch.
question (ar): ما مشكلة الاستعلامات N+1؟
right answer (ar): استعلام لكل عنصر بدل استعلام واحد مجمّع
why (ar): 100 عنصر = 101 استعلام؛ الحل JOIN أو جلب مجمّع.
